title: Multi-Turn Agent Threads, Syntax-Highlighted Diffs, Tab Context Actions & AGY/Gemini Harness Support
summary: Introduces multi-turn coding agent threads with live SSE streaming and transcript persistence in a new Threads sidebar pane, Chroma syntax-highlighted diffs across unified and split views, thread-backed inline and batch code editing, native support for agy and gemini agent harnesses, tab context menus with batch closing actions, and file tree copy shortcuts.

categories.name: Multi-Turn Agent Threads & Sidebar Conversation Pane
items: Thread store and turn runner with persistent session continuity, replay, and transcript storage under user config directory
Dedicated Threads pane in the right inspector with real-time SSE streaming for replies, status, and tool steps
Thread actions wired to selection toolbars, editor right-click context menu, and keyboard shortcuts
Thread-backed inline and batch code edits routed through thread management with comment queueing and cancellation
Replaced line hover pencil button with thread icon and contextual action menu
Rich markdown rendering and code copy buttons within thread messages

categories.name: Agent Harness Integrations (AGY & Gemini)
items: Native stream-json event parsing and session handling for Google Antigravity (agy) and Gemini agent harnesses
Updated thread execution internals and configuration documentation for multi-harness agent workflows
Deterministic agent snapshot diffing with sorted changed-file tracking across iterations

categories.name: Syntax-Highlighted Diff Views
items: Fast server-side Chroma syntax highlighting parsed directly into structured diff hunks
Structured hunk tokenization and highlighted HTML payload delivery via /api/diff (supporting diff, prDiff, and yourDiff)
Unified and split diff view rendering with full language token styling across addition, deletion, and context lines
Unit test coverage for diff hunk tokenization and edge-case parsing

categories.name: Tab Management & Explorer Ergonomics
items: Tab right-click context menu with selective batch closing: Close Tab, Close Others, Close to the Right, and Close All
Optimized batch tab dismissal using descending index splicing and concurrent Promise.allSettled backend cache evictions
Right inspector reopen button in header with automatic tab restoration when sidebar is collapsed
File tree context menu actions to quickly copy relative paths, absolute paths, and file names
Accessibility attributes and click-outside listeners dismissing context menus on escape, scroll, resize, or blur
